title: Concept: SHA-1 selected by name (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, naming SHA-1 (createHash('sha1')) requests a deprecated digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string. The javascript-specific remedy is selecting createHash('sha256').
applicability: javascript codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
